gloss: to carry over; to put off (until later)

definitions.gloss: to carry over; to put off until later
definitions.explanation: To leave a matter unsettled and carry it over to a later time, such as the next meeting, the next year or the next game.

examples.japanese: ⟦{結論|けつろん}→結論：02704_ketsuron⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{来週|らいしゅう}→来週：00746_raishuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{持|も}ち{越|こ}した。
examples.english: We put off the conclusion until next week.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{課題|かだい}→課題：00132_kadai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{来年|らいねん}→来年：00745_rainen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{持|も}ち{越|こ}したく⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: I don't want to carry this year's problems over into next year.

examples.japanese: ⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{中断|ちゅうだん}→中断：05218_chuudan⟧し、⟦{決着|けっちゃく}→決着：13251_kecchaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{翌日|よくじつ}→翌日：17960_yokujitsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{持|も}ち{越|こ}された。
examples.english: Rain halted the game, and the result was carried over to the next day.

notes:
The noun is {持|も}ち{越|こ}し, as in ⟦{次回|じかい}→次回：13170_jikai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{持|も}ち{越|こ}し (carried over to next time). The passive {持|も}ち{越|こ}される is common in news about talks and votes.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{結論|けつろん}→結論：02704_ketsuron⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{持|も}ち{越|こ}す: to put off a conclusion
- ⟦{次回|じかい}→次回：13170_jikai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{持|も}ち{越|こ}す: to carry over to next time
- ⟦{決着|けっちゃく}→決着：13251_kecchaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{持|も}ち{越|こ}される: the outcome is deferred

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{延期|えんき}する→延期する：02517_enkisuru⟧: to postpone (an event or date)
- ⟦{先送|さきおく}りする→先送りする：27000_sakiokurisuru⟧: to put off — often critical, implying avoidance
